danhite · Oct 31, 2026

> env.QUEUES[1 + hour % 2]

// results in index 1 or 2 as js has precedence for */% over +-

So something like the following, for your desired visual succinctness? ...

env.QUEUES[hour % 2 ^ 1]

// results in desired js index 0 or 1

I wonder if any of you using AI code assistance regularly might tell an old hack like me if your code review tools would have caught such a bug?

b_llc · Oct 31, 2026

Cloudflare R2 bills on writes ($4.50/M), reads ($0.36/M), and storage ($0.015/GB/mo). The free tier gives you 1M writes, 10M reads, and 10GB per month. If you batch uploads hourly, you only make ~720 writes a month. That completely eliminates write costs, leaving storage as the only expense.
